e049be9102b34cc4.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Mechanical Maintenance Engineer - HVAC with extensive experience in petrochemical plants. e080b6a24aeadbed.description: About the Role Lucidya is looking for a hands-on, forward-thinking IT Manager to own and modernize our internal technology ecosystem. This is not a traditional IT support role, and it is not a role for someone whose first instinct is to buy another SaaS tool. Our default is to build before we buy : we want someone who uses agentic AI (AI coding agents, LLM-powered workflows, and autonomous agents) to design, build, and run internal tools that fit exactly how Lucidya works. We buy third-party software only when building clearly doesn’t make sense. You will lead a small IT team by example. You set the direction, but you are also the person who configures the firewall, writes the integration, and ships the internal tool yourself. You will work proactively with People (HR), Finance, Legal, and every other relevant department to find inefficiencies before anyone reports them, especially across onboarding, offboarding, and the full lifecycle of company assets. Key Responsibilities Agentic AI and Internal Tooling Lead the use of agentic AI and AI coding tools to build internal applications, automations, and integrations in place of new third-party subscriptions wherever practical. Run a build-vs-buy assessment for every new tooling request and for existing SaaS renewals. Replace paid tools with internally built solutions where that reduces cost, complexity, or lock-in. Design, deploy, and maintain AI agents and AI-powered workflows that remove repetitive work across IT, HR, Finance, and operations. Treat internal tools as products: gather requirements from internal users, ship iteratively, document, monitor, and keep improving them. Set standards for how internal AI-built tools are secured, reviewed, version-controlled, and maintained so they remain reliable as the company grows. Asset Management Own the full lifecycle of company assets (laptops, peripherals, network equipment, licenses, and other hardware and software) from procurement and receipt through assignment, maintenance, repair, recovery, and disposal. Build and maintain a single, accurate source of truth for all assets, with clear ownership, location, condition, warranty, and assignment history. Manage asset logistics for a fully remote, multi-country workforce, including shipping, collection, and secure recovery of devices from departing employees. Work with Finance on asset purchasing, budgeting, capitalization, depreciation, and reconciliation, and run regular asset audits. Manage device enrollment, configuration, and security through MDM, including remote lock and wipe when needed. Track software licenses and SaaS seats, reclaim unused licenses, and eliminate waste. Cross-Department Operational Efficiency Proactively partner with People, Finance, Legal, Security, Engineering, and other teams to map their processes and identify opportunities for automation and simplification, without waiting to be asked. Own an end-to-end, automated onboarding experience: account creation, access provisioning, device preparation and delivery, and day-one readiness, coordinated with HR and hiring managers. Own a reliable, automated offboarding process: same-day access revocation, data handover, asset recovery, and license reclamation, coordinated with HR and Finance. Automate approvals, reporting, procurement requests, and support workflows across departments. Define and report on operational metrics (time to onboard, offboarding completion, asset recovery rate, SaaS spend, ticket volume) and use them to drive continuous improvement. Infrastructure, Identity, and Security Own and manage Lucidya’s internal IT systems, SaaS applications, identity, access, networks, and technology operations. Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot office network and internet infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, Wi-Fi access points, and fiber connectivity. Diagnose and resolve firewall, internet, fiber, LAN, DNS, DHCP, and Wi-Fi issues, coordinating with ISPs and vendors when required. Manage identity and access practices, including SSO, MFA, RBAC, and automated provisioning and deprovisioning. Work closely with Security and Data Protection to keep internal systems compliant with company policies and applicable regulations (such as Saudi PDPL). Maintain documentation, monitoring, and operational reliability across internal systems and office infrastructure. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and grow the IT team, setting clear priorities, standards, and accountability. Lead by example: stay hands-on in day-to-day technical work, and model the automation-first, build-first mindset you expect from the team. Upskill the team on agentic AI tools and modern automation practices. 6+ years of experience in IT, systems engineering, network administration, business systems, or a related technical role, including at least 2 years managing a team. A track record of leading by example: you have managed people while remaining hands-on with infrastructure, scripting, and integrations. Proven, hands-on experience in IT asset management , including lifecycle management, inventory systems, MDM, audits, license management, and coordination with Finance. Experience managing assets for remote or distributed teams is a strong plus. Demonstrated experience using agentic AI or AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to build working internal tools, not just experimenting with them. Experience with AI APIs, LLMs, and building AI agents or AI-powered workflows. Examples of replacing or avoiding third-party tools by building internal solutions, with measurable cost or efficiency results. Experience designing and running automated onboarding and offboarding processes in partnership with HR and Finance. Strong scripting ability in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PowerShell, or similar. Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, OAuth, SSO, and system integrations. Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or Workato. Hands-on networking experience configuring and troubleshooting firewalls, routers, switches, Wi-Fi networks, and business internet and fiber connections. Solid understanding of identity management, cybersecurity, and access controls. Strong communication skills and the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders across departments. Ideal Candidate You combine the mindset of an IT Manager, a Systems & Network Engineer, an AI-native builder, and an Internal Product Owner. When someone asks for a new tool, your first question is: “Can we build this ourselves, quickly and securely, with AI?” When you see a manual process, you ask: “Why are we doing this by hand, and how do we automate it?” You don’t wait for HR or Finance to come to you with a problem. You go to them with a better way of working. You lead your team from the front. You can spend the morning planning next quarter’s roadmap with the Finance team, the afternoon shipping an internal tool with an AI coding agent, and still be the one who figures out why the office Wi-Fi is down and gets everyone back online. Success in This Role Success will be measured by: Accurate, audit-ready asset records with high device recovery rates and minimal asset loss. Fast, fully automated onboarding and offboarding, with access revoked on the last day without exception. Reduced SaaS spend through internally built tools and reclaimed licenses. Meaningful internal tools and AI agents in active use across departments. Measurable efficiency gains for HR, Finance, and other teams from proactive process improvements. Reliable and secure office network and internet connectivity. Strong identity, access, and security governance across internal systems. A capable, motivated IT team that shares the build-first, AI-first mindset.

e0c9d90fb5a38a4a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المباني السريعة للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بشكل دقيق. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية ومتابعة إعداد المخططات وتدقيقها. متابعة إعداد جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية وتدقيقها. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمقاولات. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. مهارات إشرافية ممتازة لضمان جودة التنفيذ. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات بحائل. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع والإشراف المباشر على سير العمل لضمان الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية والمواصفات الفنية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في حائل، وتقدم فرصة للمهندسين المدنيين ذوي الخبرة للمساهمة في مشاريع إنشائية مهمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

e060f62f8cf1cce0.description: Job description Consultant - Cybersecurity, Penetration Testing Date: 22 Oct 2026 Custom Field 1: 733155 Location: Riyadh, SA #job-location.job-location-inline { display: inline; } Facility: Technology & Engineering Job Description OVERVIEW Job Title Consultant Job Code 733155 Grade I3 Group Legal, Risk & Governance Division Technology Department Cybersecurity Unit PT&VA ROLE PURPOSE The aim is to state the overall significance of the job from the organization’s perspective. The role exists to support the identification and assessment of cybersecurity weaknesses through the planning and execution of authorized penetration testing engagements across applications, infrastructure, and other agreed technology environments. The role provides technical analysis and practical remediation recommendations, validates corrective actions, and contributes to the continuous improvement of penetration testing practices to strengthen the organization’s cybersecurity posture. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & ACTIVITIES This section describes the principal outputs required from the job. Key Accountabilities Key Activities Engagement Scoping & Planning Define testing objectives, scope, prerequisites, and deliverables with asset owners and relevant cybersecurity stakeholders. Prepare engagement plans and rules of engagement covering authorization, permitted techniques, testing windows, and escalation arrangements. Assess testing risks and coordinate access and operational safeguards before commencing approved activities. Application & API Penetration Testing Perform authorized penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, and APIs within the agreed scope. Assess authentication, authorization, session management, input handling, and business logic controls using manual and automated techniques. Validate identified weaknesses and document reproducible evidence and potential business impacts. Infrastructure & Platform Penetration Testing Assess in-scope internal and external networks, systems, and cloud environments for exploitable weaknesses and configuration gaps. Evaluate attack paths, privilege boundaries, and exposure of sensitive services through controlled testing within approved limits. Coordinate with technical owners to manage testing dependencies and promptly escalate unexpected operational impacts. Vulnerability Validation & Risk Analysis Analyze testing results, remove false positives, and assess the exploitability and impact of confirmed findings. Prioritize findings using the approved risk assessment approach, considering asset criticality, exposure, and compensating controls. Identify related weaknesses and attack chains to explain potential impacts on critical services and information assets. Technical Reporting & Remediation Advisory Produce penetration testing reports covering scope, approach, findings, supporting evidence, risk ratings, and remediation recommendations. Communicate technical findings and business implications to asset owners and relevant stakeholders. Advise technical teams on practical corrective measures and clarify findings throughout remediation. Remediation Validation & Closure Conduct retesting to verify corrective actions and assess whether identified weaknesses have been adequately addressed. Maintain accurate finding status and supporting evidence, and escalate overdue or unresolved issues through established channels. Document residual weaknesses and provide technical input to formal closure or risk acceptance decisions by authorized owners. Testing Methods, Tools & Quality Maintain and improve testing procedures, checklists, and reusable scripts in line with approved methodologies. Evaluate testing tools and techniques in controlled environments and recommend improvements to coverage and efficiency. Review technical evidence and reports, share specialist knowledge, and provide guidance to colleagues to support consistent testing quality. Stakeholder Coordination & Technical Research Coordinate engagement schedules, dependencies, and deliverables with business stakeholders, technology teams, and external testing providers. Research emerging vulnerabilities and attack techniques relevant to the organization’s technology landscape and incorporate applicable scenarios into approved testing. Maintain engagement records and handle credentials, test data, and evidence securely throughout testing and closure. Policies, Processes & Procedures Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Comply with all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure a healthy and safe work environment. Information Security Comply with all relevant information security practices and standards to ensure data integrity and confidentiality. JOB SPECIFICATIONS Academic and professional qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications in penetration testing or offensive security are considered an advantage. Years and Nature of Experience 4–6 years of experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, or offensive security, including hands-on testing, technical reporting, and remediation validation Job Segment: Information Security, Computer Science, Engineer, Consulting, Technology, Research, Engineering, Service Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

e05e1bf64a1b7af8.description: Job description About the job E&I ENGINEER (CS) We are seeking an experienced E&I Engineer (Construction Support – CS) with 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. Verify cable routing, equipment accessibility, installation clearances, maintenance access, and interface requirements before execution. Support constructability reviews and identify potential installation constraints, routing conflicts, and design discrepancies. e0c593f013930119.job_title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Service Suite
e0c593f013930119.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why this role matters Customer service is evolving faster than ever. Customers expect instant, personalized support, while support teams are under constant pressure to resolve issues faster without sacrificing quality. AI is fundamentally changing how support organizations operate, and we're building the products that will define that future. As our Principal Product Manager , you'll own the strategy and direction of Lucidya's Customer Service Suite , including OmniServ, our ticketing and case management platform, mobile experience, and the AI-powered capabilities that enable support teams to work smarter. This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a backlog. You'll define where the product goes, make difficult prioritization decisions, and shape experiences that thousands of users rely on every day. You'll spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, and turn those insights into products that solve meaningful problems. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, questions assumptions, and is excited by building products where AI creates real customer value - not simply because it's the latest trend. What You'll Do Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Lucidya's Customer Service Suite, ensuring every investment moves the product closer to solving meaningful customer problems. Spend time with customer support teams, operations leaders, and enterprise customers to deeply understand how they work, where they struggle, and what would genuinely improve their day-to-day experience. Work closely with Engineering and Design to continuously deliver valuable improvements, favouring learning through iteration over waiting for perfection. Make thoughtful product decisions by balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical complexity, and long-term platform strategy. Champion AI-powered experiences that genuinely improve agent productivity and customer outcomes, rather than adding technology for technology's sake. Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure new capabilities are successfully adopted and create measurable business impact after launch. Use customer feedback, product analytics, market trends, and experimentation to continuously improve the product and validate product decisions. Create alignment across stakeholders by communicating product strategy, priorities, trade-offs, and roadmap decisions with clarity and confidence. Build trust across cross-functional teams by creating a collaborative environment where great ideas can come from anyone. Who You Are You've spent 7-9 years building B2B SaaS products and have owned a product or product suite end-to-end—not just individual features. You enjoy solving customer problems more than shipping features. You naturally ask "What problem are we solving?" before deciding "What should we build?" You're comfortable making difficult prioritization decisions and explaining the reasoning behind them, even when not everyone agrees. You enjoy spending time with customers and believe the best product decisions come from understanding real user behaviour rather than assumptions. You collaborate exceptionally well with engineers and designers. You don't need to write production code, but you're technical enough to challenge ideas, understand trade-offs, and make informed decisions together. You're naturally curious. Whether it's a new AI capability, workflow automation tool, or emerging technology, you've probably already experimented with it before someone asked you to. You value progress over perfection and know when it's time to ship, learn, and iterate. You're comfortable using data to support your decisions but know that numbers alone rarely tell the full story. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences alike and can simplify complex ideas without oversimplifying the problem. You'll likely have experience with Product management platforms such as Jira and Confluence. Collaboration tools including Miro and Figma. Product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar. SQL for exploring product data and validating hypotheses. Customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar. Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent productivity tools. Bonus points if you have: Previously worked in Customer Support, Customer Success, Contact Centres, or Service Operations before moving into Product. Built AI-powered workflows or automation products that delivered measurable customer outcomes. Experience designing or building enterprise customer service software. What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months) Within your first six months, you'll have built a deep understanding of Lucidya's Customer Service Suite, our customers, and the workflows that power their support operations. More importantly, you'll have: Become the go-to product leader for the Customer Service Suite, with a deep understanding of both the product and the customer problems it solves. Shipped meaningful improvements to OmniServ or the mobile experience that customers notice and that measurably improve how support teams work. Earned the trust of Engineering, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders by making thoughtful product decisions, communicating trade-offs clearly, and consistently delivering value. Built strong relationships with customers and established a regular feedback loop that directly influences product priorities. Defined and communicated a clear product roadmap that balances customer needs, business priorities, and long-term product strategy. Identified opportunities to leverage AI and automation in ways that create genuine value for support teams rather than simply introducing new technology. What the hiring process will look like Our hiring process is designed to help both you and us determine whether this is the right fit. The process typically includes: An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition. A Product Leadership interview to explore your product thinking, leadership style, and experience. A case study where you'll demonstrate how you approach solving complex product challenges and communicate your decisions. A presentation/panel interview to showcase your findings A final conversation with executive leadership / Offer discussion. Throughout the process, we're looking beyond experience alone. We want to understand how you think, how you make decisions, how you collaborate with others, and how you approach building products that customers genuinely love.
